summary: Iteration 214 frontend-only verification. (1) CLIENT bidding vehicle-list PARITY with the standard flow is FULLY IMPLEMENTED and works in the live preview. (2) DRIVER counter-offer stepper UI (− pre-filled + → Envoyer) is code-verified in IncomingRequestSheet.jsx and matches the spec (iter 213 already validated the WS sheet rendering & backend POST). (3) Standard (non-bidding) flow regression is intact: heading 'Choisissez un voyage', CTA 'Choisir SB', same renderVehicleList.

issues: When the dlat/dlng query params are pre-filled but the pickup is auto-located via IP geolocation the test runner fell back to a US datacenter (Council Bluffs, Iowa) yielding absurd Paris→Iowa distance and 9 364€ price. Not a regression introduced this iter (auto-geolocation behaviour predates 214) but worth flagging — consider falling back to the destination city's coords or to Paris default when the geolocated pickup is >100 km from the chosen destination.

critical_code_review_comments: RideChoosePage.js L86-90: showVehicles = needsDropoff (includes bidding now). L578-593: renderVehicleList renders data-testid='choose-ride-section'. L496-507 onRequest bidding branch correctly requires `selected` vehicle and navigates /taxi-bidding?...&vehicle={slug}&fare={ref}. The old renderBiddingGrid / data-testid='bidding-vehicle-section' is completely removed (confirmed absent in DOM). Good.

RideChoosePage.js L791: heading reads 'Proposez votre prix' for bidding, 'Choisissez un voyage' otherwise — both verified live. CTA at L690 reads 'Proposer mon tarif' for bidding (verified), 'Choisir {VEHICLE_LABEL}' otherwise (verified as 'Choisir SB'). Good.

IncomingRequestSheet.jsx L59 openCounter: setCounterVal(price) — pre-fills the counter-offer input with the passenger fare on first tap of toggle-counter-offer-btn. L56-58 incCounter/decCounter step by COUNTER_STEP=1 € with floor of 1 € — matches spec ('no typing while driving'). The numeric <input> is still editable (kept as a safety hatch) which is acceptable since the stepper is the primary interaction.

IncomingRequestSheet.jsx L181-185: 'Proposer un autre prix' is a prominent w-full h-12 outlined orange button (border-2 border-orange-500). After tap, the panel at L162-179 reveals minus / input / plus + full-width orange Envoyer — visually matches the user's annotated screenshot.

IncomingRequestSheet.jsx L188: 'Accepter · X €' still calls onAccept(request.id) which routes through the bidding-acceptance path in DriverHome.js (sendCounterOffer at_proposed_fare=true) — iter 213 confirmed this lands as a real ride.counter_offers entry, so this iteration introduces no regression on that path.
Minor: in IncomingRequestSheet.jsx L172 the counter-offer-input width is fixed to w-24 which on very narrow handsets may visually clip 4-digit fares like '999.50'. Cosmetic, not blocking.
